responsibility: This generated definition file provides the SARIF specification reference table used by GCC's SARIF replay code when attaching standard URLs to validation diagnostics. It defines the base URL for the SARIF v2.1.0 errata specification and a dense array mapping section numbers such as `3.52.3` to HTML anchors. Its purpose is specification-link metadata for diagnostics about SARIF structure and properties, not SARIF parsing logic itself.
